verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document an app marketplace or catalog of prebuilt integrations such as Slack, support desk, marketing, or data-warehouse connectors. What it does show is developer-facing: an App SDK for building custom apps (attio-docs-71, attio-docs-92), the note that a workspace can install an app someone has built (attio-docs-64), and webhooks and a REST API. These are developer building blocks, not an ops user installing ready-made integrations. Adjacent items like 'Real-time contact syncing' also do not show marketplace-installed integrations.
